This Arcana is a generically solid first pickup for almost all characters, except those whose starting weapon is not affected by Amount or those who have a very specialized game plan they want to start executing right out of the gate (for example

builds). It allows most characters to snowball a very powerful early game, although its usefulness later into the game is limited unless the character has an extremely powerful evolved starting weapon.
